hold_expires_at.description:
HoldExpiresAt and HoldSecondsRemaining drive the countdown on the payment
screen (PRD FR12). Both are absent once the hold no longer applies.

participants.description:
Participants names some or all of the reserved spots (PRD FR10). Spots
left unnamed are still reserved.

price_per_player_santim.description:
Santim values travel alongside the formatted strings so the client can
compute totals without parsing display text.

account_suffix.description: AccountSuffix is only needed for a bare CBE FT reference.

idempotency_key.description:
IdempotencyKey lets the app retry a submission it is unsure landed
without risking a second payment record. The Idempotency-Key header is
an accepted alternative.

transaction_reference.description:
Reference accepts what the payer has: a pasted CBE receipt link, a bare
FT reference, a CBE token, or a Telebirr reference.

expected_amount.description:
ExpectedAmount is the amount being checked against the bank, echoed so
the payer can see what we are looking for if it does not match.

message.description:
Message is what the app shows: verification is asynchronous, so this is
never a confirmation.

discount_label.description: DiscountLabel explains the deduction in the app's own words.

weeks.description: Weeks lists what the money buys, one entry per covered game.

has_password.description:
HasPassword lets the app hide "change password" for Google-only
accounts rather than offering an action that cannot succeed.

info.description:
Game discovery, spot booking, payment submission and the in-app notification feed.
Amounts are computed and verified server-side; the client never supplies the amount that is checked.
info.title: MatchUp API

post.description: Verifies a Google ID token and returns a MatchUp session, registering the account when it is new.

401.description: invalid_credentials: the Google token was not accepted

503.description: service_unavailable: Google sign-in is not configured

post.description: Signs in with an email and password and returns a fresh token pair. On the admin API the account must additionally be an admin: correct player credentials are refused with 403.

403.description: forbidden: the account may not sign in here

post.description: Revokes the session behind the refresh token. Revoking a session that is already dead is not an error.
Revokes every refresh token issued to the caller, on every device.
Sets the account's new password using the token from the reset link, and revokes every existing session.

400.description: token_expired: the link has expired or is not valid

409.description: conflict: the link has already been used

422.description: validation_failed: the new password is too weak

post.description: Mails a reset link when the address has an account. The response is identical either way, so it cannot be used to discover which emails are registered.

Sets a new password and returns a fresh token pair. Other sessions are revoked; the returned pair is the one that keeps working. 409 when the account signs in with Google and has no password to change.

409.description: conflict: this account has no password yet

422.description: validation_failed: current password incorrect, or the new one is too weak

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new token pair. Refresh tokens are single-use: replaying one that was already rotated revokes the whole session family and answers 401.
Registers a player account and returns it with a fresh token pair. Rate limited more strictly than the rest of the API.

409.description: email_in_use: that email already has an account

get.description: One page of the caller's bookings, newest first, optionally filtered to a single status.

422.description: validation_failed: unknown status or bad paging

post.description: Reserves the requested spots and returns the booking with its hold countdown. A monthly plan covers the next weekly occurrences of the same slot. Spots are released automatically when the hold lapses unpaid.
The full price breakdown for a selection — per-player price, subtotal, monthly discount and the games it would cover — without reserving anything.

get.description: The booking's games, participants and payment attempts. Another account's booking is simply not found.

post.description: Records a bank reference against the booking and checks it with the bank. Verification is asynchronous: 202 means the check has started, while 200 means an identical submission was replayed. Reusing a reference, or the same idempotency key with different contents, answers 409.

delete.description: Stops push delivery to one device, identified by its FCM token. Called at sign-out; deleting a token that matches nothing still answers 204.

requestBody.description: FCM registration token; platform is ignored

post.description: Records or refreshes the FCM registration token for the device the caller is signed in on. The token is unique system-wide: a phone that changes hands moves to the new account rather than delivering one user's notifications to another.

get.description: The fields a player can filter the discovery screen by.
Upcoming games, soonest first, with the derived availability the discovery screen renders. Filter values that cannot be parsed are rejected rather than ignored.

422.description: A query parameter could not be parsed

get.description: One game with its field and derived availability. An id that is not a UUID, or that matches no game, is a 404.

delete.description: Drops the caller's watch on a game, so no spot alert will be sent. Deleting a watch that does not exist still answers 204.

404.description: not_found: id is not a UUID

get.description: Whether the caller is subscribed to be told when this sold-out game gets a spot back. An id that is not a UUID, or that matches no game, is a 404.
get.summary: Check my watch on a game

post.description: Subscribes the caller to a push when a spot frees up on this sold-out game. Watching a game that still has spots is refused: there is nothing to wait for. Watching twice is harmless. The alert is not a reservation, so booking stays first come, first served, and the watch is spent once the alert goes out.

get.description: The caller's own account, as the app renders it.

401.description: The token is invalid, or the account no longer exists

get.description: One page of the caller's in-app feed, newest first, with the total unread count.

post.description: Marks every unread notification in the caller's feed as read and reports how many changed.
Marks one of the caller's own notifications as read. An id that matches nothing, or one that was already read, still answers 204.

404.description: not_found: the id is not a UUID

get.description: The receiving accounts a payer should send money to, one entry per payment method, read from the platform settings. These are the same values the worker checks receipts against, so the app can never show an account the backend would not verify.
